observations.observation: The query requested entity home, but retrieval included work and the fixed consumer returned Paris instead of expected Berlin.
The query requested entity primary, but retrieval returned newer project records and the consumer returned Bath instead of Berlin.
An as-of query for 2026-01-05 returned the later Paris record rather than Berlin.
An as-of query before the future move returned Paris even though Berlin was valid on that date.
An as-of query for 2026-01-09 returned Paris rather than the then-valid Berlin record.

hypothesis: Enabling entity filtering will exclude same-key records belonging to other entities, while time-aware filtering will restrict results to records valid at the requested as-of date; together these should correct the observed grounding, historical, and future-date failures without changing writes or hard constraints.
predicted_effect: Increase complete-scenario task success and relevant-memory precision, reduce distracting and stale retrieval, and avoid cross-entity leakage. Storage and write precision should remain unchanged.
